scientific_problem: Determine whether the existing FiberControl ProgramValue model recognizes high-value complete protected COMPOSE programs when those programs are present in a same-source candidate menu.
primary_output: Chronological and final pre-probe rank of one answer-known high-value complete program per cell under the unchanged FiberControl value law.
claim_boundary: This is a retrospective zero-oracle recognition diagnostic, not autonomous route generation, route following, prospective docking evidence, or a performance estimate.

selection_rule.probe: lowest historical docking score among complete-program candidates with at least four earlier same-cell candidate outcomes
selection_rule.reason: ProgramValue abstains below four observations; this rule chooses an informative known-positive probe without using its label in fitting or ranking.

candidate_menu.route_siblings: all still-unobserved complete programs from the immutable same-source curriculum archive
